functions.name: architect.entries.list
functions.title: List Architect Entries
functions.description: List structured engineering memory entries by status, tag, or text query.

tools.name: cli.powershell
tools.title: PowerShell CLI
tools.description: Execute a received PowerShell script and append every execution track to the result.

functions.name: cli.powershell.execute
functions.title: Execute PowerShell Script
functions.description: Runs a PowerShell script and returns ordered execution tracks, stdout, stderr, exit code, duration, and status.

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory. Defaults to the current JVM working directory.

timeoutMs.description: Optional execution timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 20000 and is capped by the tool.

executable.description: Optional PowerShell executable. Defaults to pwsh. Use powershell.exe for Windows PowerShell.

environment.description: Optional environment variables to add or override for the child process.

includeScriptInStructuredContent.description: Whether to echo the script body in structuredContent. Defaults to false.

tools.name: helloworld
tools.title: Hello World
tools.description: Return a greeting from an external Meshingress tool module.

name.description: The name of the person to greet

tools.name: instagram
tools.title: Instagram Fetch
tools.description: Fetches data from Instagram based on a given URL.

functions.name: instagram.fetch
functions.title: Instagram Fetch
functions.description: Fetches data from Instagram based on a given URL.

inputSchema.description: Fetches data from Instagram based on a given URL.

url.description: The URL of the Instagram post to fetch data from.

tools.name: voicebox
tools.title: Voicebox
tools.description: Call a local jamiepine/voicebox backend for speech, transcription, profiles, and health.

functions.name: voicebox.health
functions.title: Voicebox Health
functions.description: Read health, backend, GPU, and model status from the local Voicebox server.

functions.name: voicebox.speak
functions.title: Speak With Voicebox
functions.description: Submit text to Voicebox /speak and return the generation id and status for polling.

profile.description: Optional Voicebox profile name or id. Falls back to the Voicebox per-client/default binding.

engine.description: Optional Voicebox engine: qwen, qwen_custom_voice, luxtts, chatterbox, chatterbox_turbo, tada, or kokoro.

personality.description: Whether Voicebox should rewrite the text through the selected profile personality before TTS.

language.description: Optional language code. Defaults to Voicebox's en behavior when omitted.

functions.name: voicebox.transcribe_file
functions.title: Transcribe Local Audio With Voicebox
functions.description: Upload a local audio file to Voicebox /transcribe and return the transcript.

audioPath.description: Absolute path to a local audio file readable by the Meshingress process.

model.description: Optional Whisper model: base, small, medium, large, or turbo.

functions.name: voicebox.list_profiles
functions.title: List Voicebox Profiles
functions.description: List available cloned and preset Voicebox profiles.

functions.name: voicebox.generation_status
functions.title: Voicebox Generation Status
functions.description: Fetch Voicebox generation status for an id returned by voicebox.speak.

generationId.description: Voicebox generation id returned by voicebox.speak.

tools.name: webtoon
tools.title: Webtoon Downloader
tools.description: Guarded wrapper around Zehina/Webtoon-Downloader for authorized public WEBTOON metadata export and selected chapter downloads.

functions.name: webtoon.inspect
functions.title: Inspect Webtoon Request
functions.description: Validate a public WEBTOON series URL and return the safe command template without downloading images. Use export_metadata for upstream metadata extraction.

url.description: Public WEBTOON series URL, for example https://www.webtoons.com/en/.../list?title_no=123.

functions.name: webtoon.health
functions.title: Webtoon Downloader Health
functions.description: Check the configured webtoon-downloader executable, output root, safety disclaimer, and installed CLI version.

functions.name: webtoon.download_series
functions.title: Download Webtoon Series
functions.description: Download public chapters for one user-provided WEBTOON series URL. Does not bypass paid, Daily Pass, Fast Pass, app-only, or protected chapters.

outputSubdirectory.description: Optional relative output folder under the configured Webtoon output root.

latest.description: Download only the latest chapter. Cannot be combined with start or end.

saveAs.description: Storage format: images, zip, cbz, or pdf. Defaults to cbz.

separate.description: Store each chapter in a separate folder. Valid only with saveAs=images.

imageFormat.description: Optional image format: jpg or png.

exportMetadata.description: Also export metadata during the download.

exportFormat.description: Metadata format when exportMetadata is true: json, text, or all.

retryStrategy.description: Retry strategy: exponential, linear, fixed, or none. Defaults to exponential.

functions.name: webtoon.export_metadata
functions.title: Export Webtoon Metadata
functions.description: Run Zehina/Webtoon-Downloader with --export-metadata for a specific public WEBTOON series URL under the configured output root.

outputSubdirectory.description: Optional relative output folder under the configured Webtoon output root.

exportFormat.description: Metadata format: json, text, or all. Defaults to json.

latest.description: Download/export only the latest chapter. Cannot be combined with start or end.

retryStrategy.description: Retry strategy: exponential, linear, fixed, or none. Defaults to exponential.

tools.name: whatsapp.cobalt
tools.title: WhatsApp Cobalt
tools.description: Pair a local WhatsApp Web session and send text messages through Cobalt without exposing chat readers.

functions.name: whatsapp.cobalt.status
functions.title: Status
functions.description: Return the local WhatsApp Cobalt session status without exposing chats or messages.

inputSchema.description: Return the local WhatsApp Cobalt session status without exposing chats or messages.

functions.name: whatsapp.cobalt.disconnect
functions.title: Disconnect
functions.description: Disconnect the active WhatsApp session, or log out when requested.

logout.description: When true, log out and invalidate the saved WhatsApp session. Otherwise only disconnect.

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for disconnect or logout.

functions.name: whatsapp.cobalt.send_text
functions.title: Send Text
functions.description: Send a text message to a WhatsApp phone number or JID. Does not read chats or messages.

recipient.description: WhatsApp recipient as a phone number with country code or full JID.

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for Cobalt to send the message.

functions.name: whatsapp.cobalt.start_pairing
functions.title: Start Pairing
functions.description: Start a WhatsApp Web pairing flow and return either a pairing code or raw QR payload.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number with country code and digits only. Required for pairing_code.

deviceName.description: Device name shown in WhatsApp linked devices.

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for a QR payload or pairing code.

functions.name: whatsapp.cobalt.connect_registered
functions.title: Connect Registered Session
functions.description: Connect a previously paired WhatsApp Web session by alias.

deviceName.description: Device name shown in WhatsApp linked devices.

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for the registered session to connect.
